## Overview

The `lrmodel` package was designed to re-implement the base R functions `lm()` 
and `summary()` for linear regression models. The functions in this package
generate and summarize results from a linear regression model. This vignette 
demonstrates how to use the package's two core functions, `lrmodel()` and  
`lrmodel_summary()`, to fit a linear regression model and explore the results. 
It also includes a comparison of the correctness and efficiency of `lrmodel()` 
and `lrmodel_summary()` vs. the base R functions `lm()` and `summary()` using 
`all.equal()` and `bench::mark()`.

```{r, include = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  collapse = TRUE,
  comment = "#>"
)
```

```{r setup}
library(lrmodel)
```

## Correctness

The correctness of the `lrmodel()` and `lrmodel_summary()` functions are 
demonstrated below by comparing the output of each function to the base R 
functions `lm()` and `summary()` using `all.equal()`.

```{r}
all.equal(
  lrmodel(mpg ~ wt, mtcars)$coefficients, 
  lm(mpg ~ wt, mtcars)$coefficients
)

all.equal(
  lrmodel(mpg ~ wt, mtcars)$residuals,
  lm(mpg ~ wt, mtcars)$residuals
)

all.equal(
  lrmodel(mpg ~ wt, mtcars)$fitted.values,
  lm(mpg ~ wt, mtcars)$fitted.values
)

all.equal(
  lrmodel_summary(lrmodel(mpg ~ wt, mtcars))$residuals,
  summary(lm(mpg ~ wt, mtcars))$residuals
)

all.equal(
  lrmodel_summary(lrmodel(mpg ~ wt, mtcars))$sigma,
  summary(lm(mpg ~ wt, mtcars))$sigma
)

all.equal(
  lrmodel_summary(lrmodel(mpg ~ wt, mtcars))$r.squared,
  summary(lm(mpg ~ wt, mtcars))$r.squared
)
```

## Efficiency

The efficiency of `lrmodel()` and `lrmodel_summary()` vs. the base R functions
is demonstrated below using `bench::mark()`.

```{r}
result <- bench::mark(
  lrmodel(mpg ~ wt, mtcars)$coefficients,
  lm(mpg ~ wt, mtcars)$coefficients
)
```

```{r, fig.width=7, fig.height=5, out.width="100%"}
result
plot(result)
```

```{r}
result <- bench::mark(
  lrmodel(mpg ~ wt, mtcars)$residuals,
  lm(mpg ~ wt, mtcars)$residuals
)
```

```{r, fig.width=7, fig.height=5, out.width="100%"}
result
plot(result)
```

```{r}
result <- bench::mark(
  lrmodel(mpg ~ wt, mtcars)$fitted.values,
  lm(mpg ~ wt, mtcars)$fitted.values
)
```

```{r, fig.width=7, fig.height=5, out.width="100%"}
result
plot(result)
```

```{r}
result <- bench::mark(
  lrmodel_summary(lrmodel(mpg ~ wt, mtcars))$residuals,
  summary(lm(mpg ~ wt, mtcars))$residuals
)
```

```{r, fig.width=7, fig.height=5, out.width="100%"}
result
plot(result)
```

```{r}
result <- bench::mark(
  lrmodel_summary(lrmodel(mpg ~ wt, mtcars))$adj.r.squared,
  summary(lm(mpg ~ wt, mtcars))$adj.r.squared
)
```

```{r, fig.width=7, fig.height=5, out.width="100%"}
result
plot(result)
```
